section1.heading: Who I am
section1.body: I'm a Product Systems Engineer based in Dakar. I specialize in operational software — the systems that keep businesses running: internal tools, admin workflows, CRM consolidation, ERP configuration. I work in French and English, and I build for operational realities that most software ignores.

section2.heading: What I build
section2.body: I don't build marketing sites. I build the infrastructure behind them — CRMs, customer apps, acceptance test suites, admin systems, workflow automation. At Everest Finance, I operate as the technical lead consolidating three separate surfaces into one coherent system. At ERGOBIT, I built an Odoo 18 acceptance testing toolkit that brought Robot Framework discipline to a production ERP migration.

section3.heading: Beyond the work
section3.body: I play chess — not competitively, but it shapes how I think about systems: patience, positional tradeoffs, playing the long game. I came up as an operator, not an academic. That means I've managed stakeholder realities, worked inside operational constraints, and shipped software that businesses actually depend on.
